content:
Apple is rolling out the third developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, with the official release just weeks away. Here are the new features in this release.

macOS 27.2 beta 3 now available for developers

Two weeks ago, Apple released the second developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, followed shortly by the first public beta of the same version.

The most anticipated new feature in the macOS 27.2 Golden Gate beta cycle is Siri AI support for five additional languages. Previously, when macOS 27 Golden Gate launched last month, Siri AI only supported English.

Siri AI in macOS 27.2 Golden Gate will add support for French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish — as Apple promised at its Surprise and Shine event.

Apple has not yet released a macOS 27.1 Golden Gate beta, going directly to .27.2 instead. This unusual version arrangement is likely related to iPhone Duo work that Apple has kept under wraps ahead of the official unveiling of the new device earlier this month.

We're digging through this new beta now and will share anything notable that we find.

How to install macOS 27.2 beta 3

Here's how to install the first macOS 27.2 beta 3:

  • Back up your Mac
  • Open System Settings
  • Go to General → Software Update
  • Tap the "i" icon next to Beta Updates
  • From the drop-down menu in the top right, choose macOS Developer Golden Gate Beta
  • Tap Done

Have you spotted anything new in the macOS 27.2 Golden Gate developer beta 3? Tell us about it in the comments.

  • Apple Watch Series 12
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4
  • AirPods Pro 3
  • AirPods 5
  • AirTag (2nd generation) — four-pack
  • MacBook Neo
  • Logitech MX Master 4
